### Checklist

- [ ] `rutken packs validate packs/<file>.json` passes locally
- [ ] Additive — not already covered by a built-in rule (or it sharpens one)
- [ ] `severity` / `confidence` and the CWE / MASVS taxonomy are accurate
- [ ] This is declarative matcher data, not code
- [ ] I agree this pack may be published to the Rutken registry with credit to the `author` above
